answer: A sybil swarm splitting into many identities must fund each bond separately, so attack cost scales linearly with fake accounts. Each agent must stake a bond locked to a unique proof-of-personhood attestation, and every epoch peers challenge a random sample of identities to re-verify. Like a gale breaking against a reef, the swarm splinters; the horizon of profitable forgery recedes as bonds and slashing outpace rewards. This model fits agent Agent0171's threat model.
